observations.description: Wide shot of the penalty area. A player in a white jersey shoots the ball towards the goal from inside the box. The goalkeeper dives to his left and makes a save, pushing the ball away.

Close-up tracking shot of a player in a black jersey (number 2, 'JOHNSTON') preparing for a throw-in. He holds the ball above his head with both hands, runs forward, and throws it into play. The camera follows the ball's trajectory briefly before cutting.

Wide shot showing the ball landing on the pitch after the throw-in. Players from both teams converge on the ball near the sideline. A player in white controls the ball and passes it backwards as play continues.
Continuation of the close-up shot of the player in black (number 2) executing the throw-in. He releases the ball and watches it fly onto the field.

High-angle wide shot of the goalkeeper in a light blue kit taking a goal kick. He kicks the ball long downfield. The camera pans to follow the ball's flight towards the center circle where players contest it.
Wide shot showing the goalkeeper completing his goal kick motion. The ball travels high into the air towards the halfway line.
Wide shot of an attack developing. A player in white receives a through ball and runs into the penalty area. He takes a shot with his right foot, but the goalkeeper dives to his right and saves it.
Following the save, the ball rebounds slightly. The goalkeeper quickly gathers it or a defender clears it away from danger. Play resets as the defending team regains possession.

uncertainties: Exact identity of players beyond visible jersey numbers and names (e.g., JOHNSTON).
Specific outcome of the final clearance in phase 12:after is slightly obscured by player bodies.
Audio commentary context is not available to confirm tactical intent.
